Chapter 644: Chapter 1: Land Beyond (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 644: Chapter 1: Land Beyond (5000 words, please subscribe)

“Is this the feeling of having complete control over the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?”

Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will floated high, overlooking the entire secret realm.

Whether they were native lives or the Ninth Rank different species.

With just a thought, the power of the realm could erase them.

Inside the realm, even beings of Tenth or Eleventh Rank couldn’t withstand Lin Yuan’s murderous intent.

Of course, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm allowed only invincible beings of the Eighth Layer and Ninth Rank lives to enter; there were no threats from Tenth or Eleventh Tier beings.

...

“I can leave the realm whenever I wish…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm had only an entrance, no exit.

To leave, one had to wait until the period just before the secret realm closed, a hundred years after it opened, while being in the outer area.

At the specified time, one could be expelled out of the realm.

But now, as the master of the realm, Lin Yuan naturally wasn’t bound by these rules.

To leave when he wanted.

To enter when he wanted.

“It’s better to leave the realm with the main force.” Lin Yuan was not in a hurry.

He was unsure if there were any Supreme Beings outside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm at the moment. Even if he left the realm silently, facing a Supreme Being, caution was always advisable.

Swish.

Just as Lin Yuan was meticulously observing every detail inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, a Six-Armed Silhouette appeared beside him and slightly bowed, saying:

“Master.”

He was the ‘consciousness’ of this secret realm, and since Lin Yuan had refined the realm, he had become its master.

With Lin Yuan’s authority at this moment, he could completely erase the Six-Armed Silhouette and then operate the realm to reproduce a new consciousness of the secret realm.

But there was no need for that.

“Master, cultivating the ‘Primordial Yellow Physique’ requires a large amount of Xuanhuang Crystals,” the Six-Armed Silhouette stated immediately.

Before Lin Yuan completely refined the core of the secret realm, he still had control over the realm and knew how many Xuanhuang Crystals Lin Yuan had used.

“Inside the realm, there are many cultivated Xuanhuang Beasts, which are condensed from the power of the entire realm. Master needs the Xuanhuang Crystals, you may harvest those Xuanhuang Beasts but try not to harvest too many at once…”

The Six-Armed Silhouette hesitated for a moment and cautiously said.

If it were not for replenishing the essence of the realm, how could the accumulated Xuanhuang Crystals, gathered over countless millennia in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, amount to only the size of a small hill?

It should be thousands, ten thousand, or even a million times that of the hill.

The reason is that the vast majority of Xuanhuang Crystals dissipate on their own, returning into the essence of the secret realm,

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The so-called Xuanhuang Beasts are the native lives of the secret realm.

He clearly understood the concerns of the Six-Armed Silhouette.

With his current control over the realm, killing those Xuanhuang Beasts and extracting the Xuanhuang Crystals was simpler than eating and drinking.

Even if he killed all the native lives in the whole secret realm, it wouldn’t take much time.

But doing so would inevitably lead to the weakening and even collapse of the secret realm within a million years.

The collapse of the secret realm, for Lin Yuan as its master, wouldn’t cause any irreparable loss.

However, for the Six-Armed Silhouette, it would be a thorough death.

For that reason, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t proceed that way.

The sustainable development of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was far more important than draining it dry.

Most crucially, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm would become Lin Yuan’s life-saving method, second only to the Door to the Myriad Realms.

Even if, in the future, an extreme scenario occurred where Lin Yuan was chased by a group of Supreme Beings.

Should all other escape methods prove useless, he could still retreat into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

For many millennia, the Supreme Beings in the Main Universe watched the Xuanhuang Secret Realm open many times, which shows they couldn’t contend with the realm.

Lin Yuan hiding inside the realm was absolutely safe.

Compared to the ‘physical traverse’ of the Door to the Myriad Realms across dimensions and planes,

retreating into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm did not require spending World-Breaking Origin Force, and Lin Yuan could enter with just a thought.

Moreover, the ‘physical traverse’ of the Door to the Myriad Realms posed too many risks, showing such power to break through dimensions and planes in front of a Supreme Being? That kind of power might drive a Supreme Being mad.

Moreover, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm could isolate internal and external causality.

As long as one was inside the realm, beings outside the realm could not sense any related causality; only beings inside the realm could sense it.

When the Xuanhuang Secret Realm opened, Hunyi of the Tianyu Clan, the mightiest life form, pursued Lin Yuan and once requested the Maduo Traveler to sense Lin Yuan’s causality and lock onto his location.

This was possible because the Maduo Traveler was also inside the realm.

What does this mean?

As long as Lin Yuan left an Avatar, or more precisely, just a drop of his blood within the realm,

Under the isolation of causality, no curse-killing skills could completely kill Lin Yuan, not even a Supreme Being.

Therefore—

In Lin Yuan’s eyes,

The value of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm far exceeded those Xuanhuang Crystals.

Especially for a power, it was basically an utterly safe ‘lair.’

“Now, if I wish to establish a power…” Lin Yuan pondered slightly.

He held so many Bloodline Evolution Elixirs in his hand, and once the secret realm closed this time, he could harvest even more, plus the permission to establish a human race family prefix after advancing to an Eighth-Level citizen.

Along with the backyard of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm,

Lin Yuan truly possessed all the prerequisites for establishing a deeply rooted, formidable power.

The only flaw was the lack of confidants under his command, primarily because Lin Yuan had been in the Main World for too short a time.

And Lin Yuan’s lack of interest in breeding offspring meant that the Lin Family was still only a few people.

“Take it slow.”

“I have a long lifespan.”

Lin Yuan converged his thoughts; he had no interest in establishing a power, but once he became strong, establishing a power would inevitably become necessary.
